research_methods.need: Discover if a field exists / its name
research_methods.note: explain shows the SCHEMA (all possible fields). Use --recursive for the tree, drop it for descriptions.

research_methods.how: kubectl get pods (LIST) needs .items[*]   |   kubectl get pod X (SINGLE) has NO .items
research_methods.note: Check with: kubectl get pods -o json | jq 'keys'  -> if 'items' present, it's a list.

research_methods.need: Avoid prompt glued to output (no trailing newline)
research_methods.how: Append {"\n"} inside jsonpath: -o jsonpath='{.field}{"\n"}'  OR use jq -r
research_methods.note: JSONPath never adds a newline. jq -r always does.
Anything using a pod template (Deploy/STS/DS/Job) -> .spec.template.spec.containers. Only a Pod has .spec.containers.
Count them first: kubectl get pod X -o json | jq '.spec.containers | length'

research_methods.need: Filter pods by condition (JSONPath can't filter)
research_methods.how: kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase=Running   OR   ... -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.phase=="Running") | .metadata.name'
research_methods.note: kubectl JSONPath does NOT support ?(@...==...) filters.
